transcript: My friend, depression is not a sign of weakness. It is a sign that your heart has been carrying too much for far too long. In Chinese wisdom we say, when the sky is darkest, the stars are closest to the earth. It means this, your pain is not here to destroy you. It is here to awaken something inside you. You are not broken, you are tired. There is a big difference. Some days your mind feels like a storm, some days like an empty room. Both are part of healing. Both are how the spirit speaks when it needs gentleness, not force. And beneath the sadness, beneath the confusion, there is still a small flame inside you. It never went out. It is simply waiting for you to return to it. If today feels heavy, just remember, you have survived every difficult day until now. This one will not defeat you either. You will rise again, not because life becomes easy, but because your spirit was made to heal. If you feel this right, I'm still here in the comments. Sometimes just saying it out loud is the first step back to yourself.
